Implemented REG-FR-02 in `src/config/name.ts` with full unit coverage.

## What changed

**`src/config/name.ts`** (new)
- `sanitizeAppName` — lowercase, collapse every non-`a-z0-9` run to one hyphen, trim, truncate to 32 characters, trim a hyphen left at the truncation boundary.
- `repositoryBasename` / `deriveAppName` — supports HTTPS/GitLab/git/SSH/file URLs, scp-style remotes, POSIX/Windows local paths, percent-encoded basenames, trailing slashes, query/fragment, and case-insensitive `.git` suffixes.
- Rejects empty derivations and purely numeric derived names (ambiguous with ports/counts); `123-app` remains valid.
- `validateAppName` / `isValidAppName` — exact documented allowlist `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$`.
- `resolveAppName(source, override?)` and `resolveAppName({ source, name })` — explicit `--name` is validated, not silently sanitized.
- `appNameExists` / `assertAppNameAvailable` — validates before joining paths, detects directories, files, and broken symlinks; collisions throw `ConflictError` with exit code 6 and `APP_NAME_CONFLICT`, never overwriting.
- Naming errors redact URL credentials, strip control characters, and always carry remediation.

**`tests/unit/config-name.test.ts`** (new) — 38 tests covering GitHub/GitLab URLs, `.git`, scp-style, local/Windows paths, unicode, reserved-looking names, over-long names, numeric ambiguity, invalid overrides, traversal attempts, collisions, and sanitization invariants.

## Requirement coverage

- **REG-FR-02** — derivation, sanitization, override validation, collision refusal.
- **PRD-SP-05** — names validated against the allowlist before filesystem use.
- Supporting: **PRD-NF-03** (validation before mutation), **PRD-NF-10 / PRD-SP-02** (no credential leakage in naming errors).

## Validation results

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `npm run typecheck` | Pass |
| `npm test -- tests/unit/config-name.test.ts` | Pass — 38 tests |
| `npm run lint` | Pass |
| `npm test` | Pass — 202 tests across 7 files |
| `npm run build` | Pass |

(`npm ci` was run first because the sandbox had no `node_modules`; no tracked dependency files changed.)

## Contract notes

- No changes to exit codes, JSON fields, config keys, or file modes.
- New stable diagnostic codes: `AMBIGUOUS_APP_NAME` (exit 1) and `APP_NAME_CONFLICT` (exit 6).
- New public interfaces: `AppNameError`, `AppNameRequest`, `AppsDirectoryLocation`, `sanitizeAppName`, `repositoryBasename`, `deriveAppName`, `validateAppName`, `isValidAppName`, `isAmbiguousAppName`, `resolveAppName`, `appNameExists`, `assertAppNameAvailable`.

## Assumptions

- Numeric ambiguity applies only to derived names; an explicit `--name 123` is accepted because it matches the documented pattern.
- Trailing hyphens such as `foo-` remain valid for overrides because the documented regex permits them; derivation never produces one.
- No reserved-name list exists in the PRD; `CON`, `NUL`, `config`, `apps`, `doctor` are allowed as ordinary Linux directory names.
- Collision detection is a read-only pre-check; REG-1.4’s allocation lock must close the check-to-create race.
